name: Sarah
intro: Sarah is the Principal Instructor and has been instructing since 2000. She is a canine first aider and an examiner for the Royal Kennel Club Good Citizen Dog Scheme at all levels.
detail: Her current dogs are rescue crossbreed Dougal, who has his Gold GCDS and a Bronze sniffer dog award, and Norfolk terrier Toby, who has his Bronze GCDS and eight first places at Crufts.

name: Su
intro: Su has been a daytime Instructor at CHeWs since 2018. She is a lifelong dog owner and currently has Alfie, a Labrador/Poodle/Bearded Collie cross who has his Gold and is a therapy dog.
detail: Su is a canine first aider and instructs at all levels of the R.K.C.G.C.D.S.

name: Tony
intro: Tony is an ex steel worker, photographer, sailing instructor and retired science teacher, as well as a lifelong dog owner. He has been at CHeWs since 2013.
detail: His dogs include Apollo, a Springer Spaniel cross with Gold GCDS, and Chester, a mixed breed rescue with Silver GCDS. Tony is a canine first aider and a Silver R.K.C.G.C.D.S assessor.

name: Ben
intro: Ben completed three years of animal care and management at college. After completing two weeks' work experience with CHeWs, he decided to stay and become a Mixed Ability Instructor.
detail: He covers classes and assists instructors at all levels. Ben is a canine first aider and a Bronze R.K.C.G.C.D.S assessor.

name: Cliff
intro: Cliff is a retired BT technician and manager. He and Kova, a yellow Labrador Retriever with Gold GCDS and a Bronze sniffer dog award, joined CHeWs in 2017.
detail: They won the Joyce Dobson Shield for Dedication to Training in 2019. Cliff is a canine first aider, instructor and R.K.C.G.C.D.S assessor at all levels.

name: Rebecca
intro: Rebecca has been with CHeWs since it opened. She is a well-respected dog groomer and is the Wednesday Gold/Platinum instructor at CHeWs.
detail: Rebecca was until recently owned by Harley, a Cavalier/Bichon cross who achieved Gold GCDS. Rebecca is a canine first aider and R.K.C.G.C.D.S Bronze assessor.

name: Martin
intro: Martin is a mechanical and electrical engineer working within healthcare. He is owned by Merlin, an English Springer Spaniel with Gold GCDS who worked as a search and rescue dog until recently retiring.
detail: Martin has completed multiple Institute of Modern Dog Trainers courses, including puppy training, and studies motivation and positive reinforcement. He is a canine first aider and instructor at all levels.

name: Trevor
intro: Trevor is CHeWs' resident tea and coffee maker, mop monitor and joke teller.
detail: He manages the hall maintenance and garden for the Church hall and assists with classes and all of CHeWs' fundraising events.
